description: Construction number 3260. Preserved as a display at Cairo West air base and mapped by Wrecks and Relics Online as a separate point from the several groups of withdrawn F-4Es parked elsewhere on the field which are not displays.
Preserved at Cairo West air base at 30.10655N 30.91607E which is about 3 km north of the F-4E display point. Both are carried here under one base site record.
